## Investigated, not runnable

- **FICO Xpress**: NOT INSTALLED (no Python module; commercial, no licence available)
- **Hexaly**: NOT INSTALLED (no Python module; commercial, no licence available)
- **LocalSolver/Hexaly**: NOT INSTALLED (no Python module; commercial, no licence available)
- **Choco Solver**: NOT INSTALLED (requires a Java runtime; `java` not found)

## MiniZinc

MiniZinc 2.10.1 is a modelling system; only Gecode and Chuffed are used through it. Its fzn-cp-sat (same CP-SAT engine) and its COIN-BC/HiGHS/SCIP/Gurobi/CPLEX interfaces duplicate engines already reached through native APIs and are not counted as independent solvers.
